name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: BEFORE-SEND-TRIGGER BUILD, not for production: trunk's production Sqlite.sys.mjs-based cleanup logic, unchanged, but the compose-window-open trigger is replaced with browser.compose.onBeforeSend -- runs cleanup right when the user clicks Send, awaited before the send itself proceeds, instead of at compose-window-open. Tests whether shrinking the window between cleanup and the confirmed-recovering real send avoids the mid-session reading breakage, or at least shortens it to near the send's own duration.
